comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is 1 if any comment gives a concrete real-world example (including personal experience or statistics). Feature 1 is 1 if any comment is mainly abstract logical rebuttal of the OP with no named example or analogy. Feature 1 also requires rebuttal of the OP's view and excludes analogies, which feature 0 does not address. Absence of examples in one comment does not make the other feature's value its negation, and both can be 1 on the same row via different comments.
